name: Corpse Reviver
source:
Somewhere, beyond the confines of time and space…

A lonely bar stands amidst the void.

Only lost souls wander here…

And it is your duty to serve these disoriented customers.  

[From [url=https://studio-huis-clos.itch.io/corpse-reviver]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某个地方，超越时间和空间的限制……

一个孤独的酒吧矗立在虚空之中。

只有迷失的灵魂才会在这里徘徊……

为这些迷失方向的顾客提供服务是你的责任。

[来自[url=https://studio-huis-clos.itch.io/corpse-reviver]itch.io[/url]]
